title: USS Jackson: video of multiple erratically moving UAP at night

tellings.quote: And then he shared with me video of when he was on the USS Jackson, same region, and and they were seeing multiple erratic moving UAP at night.

plain: In 2019, sailors on the USS Jackson, a Navy ship off Southern California, are said to have filmed "multiple erratic moving UAP at night", UAP being the official term for UFOs. A retired Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet tells Michels this second-hand: a man named Alexander Wiggins, who was on the ship, told him about it and showed him the video. Gallaudet places it in the same region and period as other reports of swarms of objects over Navy ships there, which would make it one more recording of the same activity.
